46:t_014:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...People like him have absolute faith in their schemes, but they're also mentally fragile.」

46:t_014:15.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If we make a wrong move, he may fly into a rage and harm the hostages who should be his trump card.」

46:t_014:16.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「A crafty man in power... In a sense, he is the most dangerous kind of person.」

46:t_014:17.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If we could catch him off guard while he's reveling in his scheme...」

46:t_014:18.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Hehehe... You hesitate. Your weakness, Earthlings, is that you let emotions like that rule you.」

46:t_014:19.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$$セツコ・オハラ$$ was the same. She, too, let them limit her actions, and...」

46:t_014:20.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, old man! You know $$セツコ$$?!」

46:t_014:21.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I am not 'old man'! My name is $$ギルター・ベローネ$$!」

46:t_014:22.en:
$$アルト$$
「So $$セツコ$$ and the others really were on this Earth.」

46:t_014:23.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Thanks, old man! That's great news!」

46:t_014:24.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Th-then take my words with you to the grave. There's nothing you can do, after all.」

46:t_014:25.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You coward! Don't act so high and mighty when you're using a cheap trick like hostages!」

46:t_014:26.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Hehehe... The barking of a beaten dog. Struggle all you like. Your life and death are already in my hands.」

46:t_014:27.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You asshole! Get down here and fight me!」

46:t_014:28.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Stop, $$ピニオン$$. ...There's no point saying anything to an idiot like him.」

46:t_014:30.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Yeah, that's right. Anyone who relies on a machine and thinks that makes them strong is a damned idiot, any way you look at it.」

46:t_014:31.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「And you know what's even funnier? It's always guys like you who think they're so clever.」

46:t_014:32.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Youuu!! Do you want to die that badly?!」

46:t_014:33.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...You're about to prove what an idiot you are.」

46:t_015:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting! $$ガロード・ラン$$, the fiery mobile suit pilot, has arrived!」

46:t_016:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「You got so worked up you didn't notice $$ガロード$$ coming. You really are an idiot.」

46:t_016:2.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You're late, $$ガロード$$! If you're gonna save us, get here sooner!」

46:t_016:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Take your complaints to $$ベローズ$$. She's the one who sent me scouting.」

46:t_016:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah! It's been a while, everyone!」

46:t_016:7.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey, $$ガロード$$. You know those people?」

46:t_016:8.en:
$$ガロード$$
「We'll talk later! The enemy's getting mad!」

46:t_017:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「All units, attack! Crush $c and the brat who interfered with me until nothing remains!」

46:t_017:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You sure talk big for someone who uses cowardly tricks!」

46:t_018:0.en:
$n
「You in the $$ガンダム$$...! I'll back you up!」

46:t_018:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I haven't seen you before, but if you're in 《$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$》, you're a friend of mine too.」

46:t_018:2.en:
$n
「We're $c. Our team carries on the ideals of 《$$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$》 and 《$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$》.」

46:t_018:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Got it! I'm counting on you!」

46:t_019:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Major $$カリーニン$$'s team has secured the civilians.」

46:t_019:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All that remains is to make that man, $$ギルター$$, pay for his foolish actions.」

46:t_019:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Roger. I'll take down that incompetent commander who relied on a cowardly scheme.」

46:t_019:3.en:
$n
「After what you've done, don't think you're getting home in one piece...!」

46:t_019:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「D-damn it! The sight of your faces disgusts me! I'll leave the rest to you!」

46:t_020:1.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Now I can't help feeling sorry for his subordinates.」

46:t_020:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「If you're going to hold a grudge, hold it against your selfish commander! All units, attack!」

46:t_020:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let's go, $$サイデリアル$$! As long as I'm here, you won't lay a finger on $$ガルガンティア$$!」

46:t_021:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Confirmed: the enemy force has been eliminated.」

46:t_021:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But that man, $$ギルター$$... He will confront us again.」

46:t_021:2.en:
$$ボビー$$
「His type really holds a grudge.」

46:t_021:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「First, we must repair the $$ダナン$$ and the $$クォーター$$.」

46:t_021:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Fortunately, we should be able to make contact with the local residents.」

46:t_021:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Leave it to me. I'll take you to the $$ガルガンティア$$ fleet.」

46:t_021:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah, that's right. They're my employers.」

46:t_021:8.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「$$ガロード$$! Before that, I've got something for you to do!」

46:t_021:9.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Those $$サイデリアル$$ bastards wrecked our salvage equipment! I'm counting on you to haul up the treasure!」

46:t_021:10.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Got it! Let's finish the job fast and head back to the fleet!」

46:t_022:0.en:
???
(...Comparing data... Partial match with allied unit confirmed...)

46:t_022:1.en:
???
(After assessing the situation, I will begin resuscitating the pilot.)

46:t_023:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If you think the $$サテライトキャノン$$ will always be limited to night firing, you're dead wrong!」

46:t_023:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Thanks to a high-capacity capacitor, I can now sortie with enough energy charged for one shot...」

46:t_023:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「And now there are reflector satellites all over! Even in daylight, microwaves from the Moon reach us in just two minutes!」

46:t_023:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm firing the $$サテライトキャノン$$! Get out of the way if you don't want to die!!」

46:t_024:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's the $$ダブルエックス$$'s Twin $$サテライトキャノン$$.」

46:t_024:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It charges up with microwaves sent from the Moon. That's where the name comes from.」

46:t_024:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You can see how powerful it is, $$サイデリアル$$! Now get the hell out of here!」

46:t_100:0.en:
$n
($$アドヴェント#pilot$$... I'll get stronger, for your sake too...)

46:t_100:1.en:
$n
(The strength to protect someone, the strength to beat any foe... I'll obtain it with $$ジェニオン$$...!)

46:t_101:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Even wounded, even here on the $$翠の地球$$, we cannot allow ourselves to lose as long as the sea is our battlefield.」

46:t_101:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All hands! Wherever we are, show them that this $$ダナン$$ is the queen of the seas!」

46:t_102:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「A vast green ocean... I like it.」

46:t_102:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
(Hey... $$モニカ$$...! What's gotten into the Captain?)

46:t_102:2.en:
$$モニカ$$
(I think surfing during atmospheric reentry must have stirred his sailor's blood...)
